competences.description: Attacks all enemies to stun for 1 turn with a 50% chance. Absorbs the Attack Bar of enemies stunned after the attack by 15%.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself
effets.note: Of enemies stunned after the attack

competences.description: When you take fatal damage, all harmful effects are removed and only the mechanical frame remains for 2 turns. Uses [Rending Claw] on all enemies when you gain a turn. While in the mechanical frame state, you gain immunity against inability effects and Attack Bar decreasing effects, and deal 50% increased damage. However, you cannot counterattack or attack together. You cannot be defeated while the effect lasts, but will die once the effect ends. [Automatic Effect]
